text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder and I have come to the
track to
watch some races.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
There she goes! Laser focused! Blazing
ahead and
across the finish liiine!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I know we planned to watch races
today... But do
you mind if we do
something different?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Listening to all those cheers.
I can't just
stand
around twiddling my thumbs.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder

around twiddling my thumbs.

this fire
within me dims.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We head back to the academy together,
and
Grass Wonder runs late into the
night.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Fair enough. I look forward to
what you
plan on adding.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Right now... I'll pay full attention to
these races
and preserve this urge to
fuel me for tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the rest of our time at the venue,
Grass
Wonder observes every race with
hawk-like
attention.
